account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Participant resource.

call_sid.description: The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) the Participant resource is associated with.

label.description: The user-specified label of this participant, if one was given when the participant was created. This may be used to fetch, update or delete the participant.

call_sid_to_coach.description: The SID of the participant who is being `coached`. The participant being coached is the only participant who can hear the participant who is `coaching`.

coaching.description: Whether the participant is coaching another call. Can be: `true` or `false`. If not present, defaults to `false` unless `call_sid_to_coach` is defined. If `true`, `call_sid_to_coach` must be defined.

conference_sid.description: The SID of the conference the participant is in.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

end_conference_on_exit.description: Whether the conference ends when the participant leaves. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `false`. If `true`, the conference ends and all other participants drop out when the participant leaves.

muted.description: Whether the participant is muted. Can be `true` or `false`.

hold.description: Whether the participant is on hold. Can be `true` or `false`.

start_conference_on_enter.description: Whether the conference starts when the participant joins the conference, if it has not already started. Can be: `true` or `false` and the default is `true`. If `false` and the conference has not started, the participant is muted and hears background music until another participant starts the conference.

queue_time.description: The wait time in milliseconds before participant's call is placed. Only available in the response to a create participant request.

uri.description: The URI of the resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.
